#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class FastScanner {
public:
    FastScanner() : in(cin) {}
    string ns() {
        while (true) {
            if (!st.empty()) {
                string res = st.front();
                st.erase(st.begin());
                return res;
            }
            string line;
            if (!getline(in, line)) {
                return "";
            }
            stringstream ss(line);
            string token;
            while (ss >> token) {
                st.push_back(token);
            }
        }
    }
    int ni() {
        return stoi(ns());
    }
private:
    istream& in;
    vector<string> st;
};

class IntegerUtils {
public:
    static vector<long long> invs(int n, long long p) {
        vector<long long> res(n);
        res[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = (p - (p / i) * res[p % i] % p) % p;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    FastScanner in;
    int n = in.ni();
    int k = in.ni();
    int l = in.ni();
    const long long mod = 998244353;
    vector<long long> invs = IntegerUtils::invs(2 * n + 3, mod);
    vector<vector<long long>> p(2 * n + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));
    p[0][1] = 1; // first is always started
    for (int i = 1; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        int prevMaxRunning = min(2 * n - i, i);
        int maxRunning = min(2 * n - i - 1, i + 1);
        for (int j = 0; j <= prevMaxRunning; j++) {
            if (p[i - 1][j] != 0) {
                if (j > 0) {
                    p[i][j - 1] = (p[i][j - 1] + p[i - 1][j] * j % mod * invs[2 * n - i] % mod) % mod; // close an interval
                }
                if (j < maxRunning) {
                    p[i][j + 1] = (p[i][j + 1] + p[i - 1][j] * (2 * n - i - j) % mod * invs[2 * n - i] % mod) % mod; // start a new interval
                }
            }
        }
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        for (int j = k; j <= n; j++) {
            if (p[i][j] == 0) continue;
            ans = (ans + p[i][j]) % mod;
        }
    }
    ans = ans * l % mod * invs[2 * n + 1] % mod;
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
